enriched.title: Present Continuous e Vocabulário sobre Aposentadoria e Varejo
enriched.summary: A aula abordou o uso do Present Continuous, incluindo sua formação, usos e exemplos práticos. Também foram ensinados vocabulários relacionados a aposentadoria e varejo, além de exercícios para prática de perguntas e respostas.
mainTopics: Formação de perguntas no Present Continuous

vocabulary.definition: Used to indicate a gradual increase in degree or amount.
examples: The weather is becoming more and more unpredictable.

vocabulary.definition: Having stopped working permanently, typically due to age.
The period of life when one stops working permanently.
examples: She is saving money for her retirement.

vocabulary.definition: To leave one's job and stop working permanently.
examples: He plans to retire at the age of 65.

vocabulary.definition: The sale of goods to the public in relatively small quantities.
examples: I’m finishing a project with a big retail company.

grammar.explanation: The Present Continuous is used to describe actions happening at the moment of speaking, temporary situations, ongoing events, and trends or changes in progress.
rules: Form the Present Continuous with the verb 'to be' in the present tense + the main verb in its -ing form.
To create negative sentences, add 'not' after the verb 'to be'.
For questions, invert the subject and the verb 'to be'.
examples: I’m studying English now / at the moment.
We’re living with my mother because we’re waiting for the keys to the new apartment.
I’m finishing a project with a big retail company.
The weather is becoming more and more unpredictable.
commonMistakes: Using the base form of the verb instead of the -ing form (e.g., 'I am work' instead of 'I am working').
Forgetting to use the verb 'to be' (e.g., 'She working' instead of 'She is working').

practiceQuestions.question: Form a sentence with 'Liam / save / money / because he wants to buy a car.'
practiceQuestions.answer: Liam is saving money because he wants to buy a car.
practiceQuestions.explanation: Use 'is' for the subject 'Liam' and the -ing form of 'save'.

practiceQuestions.question: Form a negative sentence with 'Henry / not train / because he has health problems.'
practiceQuestions.answer: Henry isn’t training because he has health problems.
practiceQuestions.explanation: Add 'not' after 'is' to form the negative.

practiceQuestions.question: Make a question with 'your friends / win / the match?'
practiceQuestions.answer: Are your friends winning the match?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Invert the subject 'your friends' and the verb 'are' for a question.

studyTips: Practice forming sentences with different subjects and verbs to get comfortable with the Present Continuous.
Focus on the correct use of 'to be' and the -ing form of the main verb.
Listen to native speakers to understand how Present Continuous is used in everyday conversations.
originalExamples: The little girl is having ice cream with her older sister. (A garotinha está tomando sorvete com sua irmã mais velha.)
Liam is saving money because he wants to buy a car. (Liam está economizando dinheiro porque ele quer comprar um carro.)
You aren’t listening to me. (Você não está me ouvindo.)
My parents are looking for a new apartment. (Meus pais estão procurando um novo apartamento.)
The victim isn’t cooperating with the police. (A vítima não está cooperando com a polícia.)
Lucas and I are planning a trip to Japan. (Lucas e eu estamos planejando uma viagem ao Japão.)
I’m cooking fish for dinner. (Estou cozinhando peixe para o jantar.)
The water is boiling. You can put the pasta now. (A água está fervendo. Você pode colocar o macarrão agora.)
Henry isn’t training because he has health problems. (Henry não está treinando porque tem problemas de saúde.)
It isn’t raining now. We can go to the park. (Não está chovendo agora. Podemos ir ao parque.)
Are you crying? (Você está chorando?)
Is your father recovering well after the operation? (Seu pai está se recuperando bem após a operação?)
Are the engineers trying to find a solution? (Os engenheiros estão tentando encontrar uma solução?)
Is the baby sleeping? (O bebê está dormindo?)
Are we doing the right thing? (Estamos fazendo a coisa certa?)
Is William studying for his exams? (William está estudando para os exames?)
Are you eating my pizza? (Você está comendo minha pizza?)
Is the client paying by credit card? (O cliente está pagando com cartão de crédito?)
Are your friends winning the match? (Seus amigos estão vencendo a partida?)
Is Tom running in the race? (Tom está correndo na corrida?)
Is Barcelona winning the game? (O Barcelona está vencendo o jogo?)
